sniper.prompt: Create a formal supplementary game sprite atlas derived faithfully from the reference SNIPER character. This is NEW AI directional concept adaptation, not an unchanged crop. Transparent background. Exactly 12 separated whole character sprites, a regular 3 rows by 4 columns grid, no text labels, no guides, no shadows, no bullets, no flashes. Preserve the reference pale sage mint color, very subtle paper texture, thick soft dark brown contour, EXACT two brown dot eyes, one brown crescent belly patch, two short feet, and long continuous neck into a narrow long beak. Same proportions as the first three rows of the reference. Feet stay planted on the same horizontal baseline in each row, two foot-contact midpoint is the same cell horizontal center, body must not rotate or shift with aiming. All outlines continuous, no detached nozzle or extra ring. Columns: upper-right diagonal beak points EXACT -45 degrees; lower-right diagonal beak points EXACT +45 degrees; lower-left diagonal beak points EXACT +135 degrees; upper-left diagonal beak points EXACT -135 degrees. Body remains upright with planted feet, head/long beak pose provides direction, not a whole-body tilt. Row1 NEUTRAL body, Row2 gently SQUASHED soft torso but rigid beak same length and thickness, Row3 gently STRETCHED soft torso but rigid beak same length and thickness. No attack row. Ensure each entire nose and both feet fully inside its cell with generous transparent padding. These four diagonals supplement the existing four cardinal directions. Avoid neon green, halo, lighting, 3D, angular corners, extra eyes or limbs.

rail.prompt: Create a NEW formal supplementary directional concept sprite atlas faithfully using the supplied RAIL tower reference. Transparent background. Exactly 12 complete separated sprites in a regular 3-row 4-column grid. No text, arrows, guide lines, shadows, lighting, halos, glow, bullets or flashes. Preserve pale sage mint paper-textured soft sticker body, dark-brown rounded contour, exactly two brown dot eyes, one darker sage belly patch, two short planted feet, long continuous neck and TWO parallel narrow rigid tubes continuously connected to the head (no detached weapons or mounting rings). Preserve the original neutral tube length and thickness and two small dark oval apertures at the tips. Upright torso and horizontally planted feet, no whole-body rotation or position shift to aim. Columns tube axes: upper-right EXACT -45 degrees; lower-right EXACT +45 degrees; lower-left EXACT +135 degrees; upper-left EXACT -135 degrees. Keep tubes parallel and constant length/thickness in all poses. Row1 neutral; Row2 gently squashed soft torso only; Row3 gently stretched soft torso only. No fourth attack row. Two-foot sole midpoint stays the cell's horizontal center, feet maintain a common row baseline across 4 cells. Head and continuous neck articulate direction while body remains upright and cute; maintain eyes, belly patch, soft spacious silhouette. Every entire tube tip, body, two feet stays inside each cell with generous transparent padding. No extra limbs, eyes, teeth, horns or tube count changes. This supplies four diagonal direction drawings to complement existing cardinal direction sprites, not vector art.
